svg.aria-label: I build things that put AI to work on real data, usually on a local model. Most of what I ship runs fully offline: no API keys, and nothing leaves the machine it runs on. Current focus: LOCAL-LLM TOOLING, docs, code review, prompt compression; AGENT BENCHMARKS, upstream CLI work on AOBench for HPC; RF · DSP, SIW antenna design, Springer Nature paper
